verdict.rationale: mParticle's Data Privacy Controls and Consent Filters docs explicitly describe capturing consent/opt-out state (GDPR consent, CCPA data sale opt-out) and applying forwarding rules to downstream integrations based on that state, directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of enforcement working correctly across all destinations, and more detail on breadth of consent categories beyond GDPR/CCPA.
